name: hf_conditions
title: HF conditions
description: For amateur radio operators: someone types 'hf' (your own trigger words) and gets the current HF band conditions - solar flux, sunspots, A and K index, X-rays, noise, and Good / Fair / Poor for 80-40m, 30-20m, 17-15m and 12-10m by day and night (from hamqsl.com, N0NBH). Only in the channels you choose, never in Public. Off until you switch it on.
